instructions:
# Task: collect official entry requirements (browser agent) - round 2

For every item in openclaw_tasks.json (school + level: bachelor/master), open the school's OFFICIAL website in a real browser
(admissions / international entry requirements / English language requirements / application fees pages; programme pages if the
general pages show nothing) and record what the page says for INTERNATIONAL applicants.

Rules
- Official institution domains only. No aggregators, agents, forums.
- Copy only what the page states. If a value is not published, use null. Never guess, never infer from another school.
- Record the exact URL of the page each value came from.
- Note programme-specific higher requirements (medicine, law, MBA, arts) in programme_variance.
- Report TOEFL on the scale the page uses (old 0-120 or new 1-6 scale from Jan 2026) and say which.

Output: a JSON list, one object per input item, same order:
{"school","level",
 "english": {"IELTS":null,"TOEFL":null,"PTE":null,"Duolingo":null},
 "english_note": "",
 "academic": "one factual sentence on the general academic entry requirement for international applicants",
 "turkish": "country-specific requirement for Turkey (Lise diploma %, minimum GPA) if published, else null",
 "application_fee": "amount with currency, 'none' if explicitly free, else null",
 "programme_variance": null,
 "source_url": "main official page used",
 "page_status": "read | blocked | not_found | js_empty",
 "confidence": "high | medium | low"}

Round 2 guidance
- tasks = phase 1 (priority): items where earlier attempts found nothing or only low-confidence data. last_attempt / last_note say what happened before.
- Many pages hide tables inside accordions, tabs or "show more" buttons: expand them in the browser and read the full DOM text (including hidden panels), and also open linked PDFs (policy / fee PDFs).
- If the English table is not on the general page, look at the programme pages, "international students", "how to apply", "fees", and country-specific pages (Turkey).
- If a site shows a CAPTCHA or blocks the browser, do not try to bypass it: report page_status "blocked" and move on.
- If the school's official domain is unknown, find it via a normal web search, then verify the page footer or about page; do not use agent/aggregator sites.
- Keep a polite pace (a few seconds between page loads).
- tasks_phase2 (only after phase 1 is finished): the English scores are already known; only find the official application_fee (amount + currency, 'none' if explicitly free) plus source_url. Return the same JSON shape with english fields null.
